title: Sandra Lambert/Quotes
summary:
"I'd caution anyone against making that choice. I know how difficult a life it can be... and how dangerous."
- Sandra Lambert to Dante Vale, about Lok Lambert joining the Huntik Foundation (Home Turf)

"Dante, please, take care of him."
- Sandra Lambert to Dante Vale, about Lok Lambert (Home Turf)

"Once a Foundation girl, always a Foundation girl." 
- Sandra Lambert to Lok Lambert (Home Turf)
